layer.capability: materializes the axial naturalRemainder branch at x0 as the mixed-scale decomposition inverseL*lin2 - inverseL*slow2/Lambda + inverseL*pressure, preserving theorem-selected 1/Lambda and the nonzero a^2 pressure scale without binary64 collapse

actual_data.mixed_scale_representation: ordinary Decimal base + explicit Decimal numerator/Lambda slow term + signed-log a^2 pressure term

validation: ordinary inverseL*lin2 is cross-checked against the previously landed full naturalRemainder with regression-only a=0,t=0 isolation
ordinary inverseL*slow2 is cross-checked against the regression-only difference naturalRemainder(t=0)-naturalRemainder(t=1) with a=0
zero-eta-derivative inverseL*pressure is independently isolated by constant a=1 minus a=0 in the existing full remainder
the final inverseL multiplication on wide pressure uses exact radial convolution and eta Leibniz expansion
Lambda is inherited from the actual theorem-selected wide amplitude and cannot be overridden
nonzero pressure remains signed-log nonzero and binary64 projection fails closed on range loss
indices and eta window fail closed
layer.remaining_boundary: materialize the angular naturalRemainder branch with theorem-selected 1/Lambda through naturalResolvent, combine both components into genuine naturalRemainder(x0), apply the outer 1/(2*Lambda) Picard scale to form Picard x1, iterate/certify the fixed-point phi/u, derive average/pressure, connect NaturalProfileAssembly, close support/moment/matching/cone conditions, and certify global all-index weighted AxisSpace membership/norms
